issues.what: the transition between the crater lake ripples and the orbital pull-back cuts to flat, mathematically perfect concentric cyan rings on a uniform dark blue field, breaking the photographic reality of the film at its pivotal reveal
issues.fix: replace the synthetic ring graphic with continuous photographic dark-water ripples and atmospheric depth bridging frame 9337 into the top-down eye-socket water in frame 9589

issues.where: frame 7015 (1:56.55) and the ice-ridge sequence (also set-A-09.png frame 7234 and set-A-03.png frames 7066-7823)
issues.what: the snowy spine-ridge place looks less finished and more stylized than the other five landscapes: the sea/ice flanks have blurry stretched low-detail noise, the lightning bolt reads as a flat white line ending in a circular flare dot without lighting the clouds or snow, and the trailing clouds look like flat painted wisps
issues.fix: add crisp scale-appropriate detail to the flanking water and ice, replace the ribbon clouds with volumetric storm mist, and integrate the lightning with realistic cloud and terrain illumination

issues.where: frame 10027 (2:47.07), the skeleton continent (also set-A-09.png frame 10027)
issues.what: the third place (the coastal karst sinkhole from frame 4221/4409) has no clearly recognizable landmark on the orbital reveal, while the four bright white lumbar-spine ovals and bright white red-veined pelvis sit slightly too stark and diagram-like compared to the naturalistic rock integration of the skull and ribcage
issues.fix: give the third place a legible coastal sinkhole landmark on the wide skeleton continent and soften the albedo and contrast of the white spine and red-veined pelvis under atmospheric haze so they blend like real landforms from orbit
